subject.title: [Feature]: Make managed browser launch degrade cleanly when no display server is available

question: Should explicit headed no-display launches keep failing with an additive structured reason/details error, or should OpenClaw add a policy-controlled headless fallback for that explicit-headed case?
rationale: Current code already handles the launch behavior split, but the remaining work changes a stable browser HTTP/client/tool error contract and potentially the compatibility policy for explicit headed mode.

options.title: Add structured error only
options.body: Preserve the current implicit-fallback versus explicit-error policy, and add reason/details fields that survive route and client boundaries.

options.title: Add opt-in explicit fallback
options.body: Introduce a narrowly documented policy/config path that allows explicit headed no-display launches to fall back headless when the operator has chosen that behavior.

options.title: Close as current behavior enough
options.body: Treat actionable text plus existing headlessSource telemetry as sufficient and leave agents to use human-facing diagnostics rather than a new stable reason code.

recommendation.title: Add structured error only
recommendation.body: Preserve the current implicit-fallback versus explicit-error policy, and add reason/details fields that survive route and client boundaries.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the current no-display fallback policy and is the current live assignee for this issue.
